welcome.title: Welcome to Low Battery Town
welcome.body: A pixel city of fellow pilots focusing together. Three modes shape how you focus here — let's take a quick tour.

city.title: CITY MODE — you're already in it
city.body: The town is City Mode. Your timer and city lofi station sync with everyone online. Focus alongside the crowd without leaving the street.

solo.title: SOLO — your private chamber
solo.body: Need silence? Enter a full-screen focus room with just your timer and notes. No buddy, no shared station.

together.title: TOGETHER — match a buddy
together.body: Pair up with another pilot for a 25-minute shared sprint. Same timer, same station, two of you working in parallel.

done.title: You're ready to focus
done.body: Press ▶ on the timer when you're ready. You can replay this tour anytime from your profile.

replay.label: Replay tutorial
replay.description: Walk through the three focus modes again
